why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Travis Bazzana is slot #4 (4.257 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #2, #3, #5, #1, #6, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.31 expected PA/game vs 4.63 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
